answer.reason: The verses tell of his being made king by the people, and of his capture by Pharaoh Necho and death in Egypt.

clauses.english: was anointed king by the people of the land in place of his father
clauses.quote: the people of the land took Jehoahaz the son of Josiah, and anointed him

clauses.english: was put in bands by Pharaoh Necho at Riblah and taken to Egypt, where he died
clauses.quote: took Jehoahaz away: and he came to Egypt, and died there

doubts: 2KI 23:31 and 2CH 36:2 only give his age and the length of his reign, so they are not cited.
JER 22:11 is a prophecy about Shallum, so it is not used for an event.
